waybackify ledger [flags] <dir>

Survey the manifests under a tree

Survey the ledger — every wayback.json manifest and captures.jsonl
capture list under <dir>, file paths as identity. Default: one JSONL
row per file with section counts. --flatten: union the manifests
into ONE canonical manifest on stdout (the seen-file bootstrap for
manifest; one capture per url). --captures: one JSONL row per
referenced capture, every version kept, with the files that name
it. --root: the same rows joined against a cache root and
classified unfetched | cached | interstitial | error.

Arguments:
  <dir>              root to discover wayback.json manifests under

Flags:
  --flatten          print the union manifest (canonical JSON) instead of rows
  --captures         print one row per referenced capture (no cache root needed)
  --root|-r <root>   classify referenced captures against this cache root
  --against <root>   deprecated alias of --root|-r
  --help|-h          Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
